scope: Research-only packet-end capture preparation and calibration for the next one-zone pairing attempt. No new valve pairing arm in these calibrations.
redaction: Received endpoints replaced consistently with synthetic values, preserving original CRC residues. Transmitted calibration endpoints were synthetic on air. Installation identifiers and private logs omitted.

candidate_behavior.capture_source: GDO1/MISO sync-to-packet-end signal, with SPI idle throughout the observed high interval
candidate_behavior.missing_or_ambiguous_edge: Do not send experimental reply; report step4_missing_edge
candidate_behavior.prefix_and_packet_ending: Retain previously accepted reply prefix and calibrated 910 us active FIFO stop

limitations: Three radio-received frames passed exact sync and captured CRC checks, and their packet-end markers preceded the FIFO poll by 40--48 us. One was independently recovered from low-gain SDR; the other two weaker frames were not recovered by that decoder.
Absolute marker timing relative to the valve RF frame end and its effect on terminal acceptance still require the next controlled pairing capture. These receive-only observations do not prove either.
Two non-CRC-valid frames are excluded from the verified calibration evidence; normal pairing request validation remains required.
